gigapan.description:
Transmission mode light microscopy of flea. This image is composed of 10 rows by 9 columns by 37 stacks deep totalling 3330 images (three threes : ) It was taken using a 20x objective. It's neat to compare to the incident mode lighting gigapan of the same subject:

http://gigapan.org/gigapans/54758/

This is part of the small worlds explorations project. http://www.smallworldexplorations.com/
